example_sentences_in_bangla: রাতের তমোজ্যোতির মতো তার আশা ছিল সামান্য।
example_sentences_in_english: His hope was like the tamojyoti in the night, faint but present.
Fireflies glowed like tamojyoti in the forest.
history: This idiom draws from observations of fireflies in rural Bengal, often featured in Bengali poetry to symbolize fleeting or dim hope.
note: Refers to the bioluminescent glow of fireflies, evoking imagery of subtle light amidst obscurity in Bengali literature.
